title: Request reset link with a registered email
preconditions: A registered, active user account exists with email user@example.com.
steps: Open the login page and click 'Forgot password'.
Enter user@example.com and submit the form.
Open the mailbox for user@example.com.
expected_result: A generic confirmation message is shown and a reset email with a link arrives within 2 minutes.

title: Complete reset with a valid password before the link expires
preconditions: A reset link was requested less than 30 minutes ago.
steps: Click the reset link in the email.
Enter the new password 'Secure#2026' in both fields.
Submit the form.
expected_result: The password is updated and the user is redirected to the login page, where the new password works.

title: Request reset link with an unregistered email
steps: Open the 'Forgot password' form.
Enter nobody@example.com and submit.
expected_result: The same generic confirmation message is shown as for a registered email, so account existence is not revealed, and no email is sent.

title: Use a reset link after it has expired
preconditions: A reset link was requested more than 30 minutes ago.
steps: Click the expired reset link.
Observe the page.
expected_result: The page states the link has expired, does not show the new-password form, and offers to request a new link.

title: Reset link at exactly the 30-minute expiry boundary
preconditions: A reset link was requested; test clock can be set to 29:59 and 30:01 after the request.
steps: Open the link at 29 minutes 59 seconds after the request.
Open the same link again at 30 minutes 01 seconds after the request.
expected_result: The link is accepted at 29:59 and rejected as expired at 30:01.

title: Reject a new password shorter than 8 characters
preconditions: A valid, unexpired reset link is open.
steps: Enter 'Ab1#xyz' (7 characters) as the new password.
Submit the form.
expected_result: The form is rejected with a message about the minimum length of 8 characters, and the password is not changed.

title: Accept a password of exactly 8 characters meeting the policy
preconditions: A valid, unexpired reset link is open.
steps: Enter 'Ab1#xyzw' (8 characters) as the new password.
Submit the form.
expected_result: The password is accepted and updated.

title: Reject a new password without a number or special character
preconditions: A valid, unexpired reset link is open.
steps: Enter 'Password' as the new password.
Submit the form.
Repeat with 'Password1' (no special character).
expected_result: Both attempts are rejected with a message that names the missing requirement, and the password is not changed.

title: Existing sessions are invalidated after a successful reset
preconditions: The user is logged in on two browsers; a reset link has been requested.
steps: Complete the password reset using the link.
In the second browser, refresh a page that requires login.
expected_result: The second browser's session is no longer valid and the user is asked to log in again.

title: A reset link cannot be used twice
preconditions: A reset link has already been used successfully.
steps: Open the same reset link again.
expected_result: The link is rejected as invalid or already used, and the password cannot be changed with it.
